note: Story clocks (Day 94): a time of day that story flags move, not a running day/night. A region names its clock ("clock": id) and its fog/light overrides name a time ("time": id) instead of an "if". The time is the first of `times` whose condition holds, so the latest time in the story goes first; none holding is `default`, which is the region's base fog and light.
